thread:
tara (CSE): Quick heads up — Clarion onboarding: long-doc summarization p95 is ~2.3s, our SLO is 800ms. Customer is on a renewal watch.
kevin (SRE): Oof. Are they on the hosted API or Dedicated? Any pattern on seq len or model? :thinking_face:
sophie (ML Eng): They're on hosted with model redwood-open-xl-v1, average prompt length ~3.5k tokens for summaries. We see KV cache miss rate high for these requests.
tara (CSE): Yep hosted. Usage spike after feed ingestion last week. Omar flagged some churn risk in renewal signal.
omar (Account Exec): Clarion mentioned budget sensitivity — want lower lat/cost. They've also asked about on-prem later this year.
kevin (SRE): First quick win: enable prefix KV caching for their summarization route, TTL 12h. Should cut repeated prefix work.
sophie (ML Eng): Agreed. Also propose two-step experiment:
1) Canary a quantized int8 variant (redwood-open-xl-v1-int8) for the summarization route.
2) Route long sequences (>2k tokens) to a compact-specialized model (redwood-compact-xl-qa) with a light prompt rewrite to preserve quality.
kevin (SRE): Routing rule sounds good. I can add a route rule in the console: if input_tokens > 2000 && customer_id == "clarion" -> model redwood-compact-xl-qa (canary 10%).
sophie (ML Eng): For the quantized canary, we'll need a short eval set (20 samples) to check regressions. I'll run the eval and post metrics.
tara (CSE): Can you also include a couple of customer-facing notes for enablement? We should coordinate a quick enablement touchpoint so Clarion understands tradeoffs.
omar (Account Exec): I'll schedule a 30m call Tue 09:30 PT — include performance screenshots and expected cost delta.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy request queued: canary redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 -> 10% traffic via policy 'clarion-int8-canary'.
kevin (SRE): Deployment looks fine. I'll add KV cache change and routing rule after Sophie posts eval pass.
sophie (ML Eng): Eval results: 20 samples, avg ROUGE-L drop 0.6%, latency p95 down 45%. I'll paste the small report and sample outputs in the doc.
sophie (ML Eng): Sample eval summary:
```
model redwood-open-xl-v1: p95 2300ms, ROUGE-L 0.72
model redwood-open-xl-v1-int8: p95 1250ms, ROUGE-L 0.716
model redwood-compact-xl-qa: p95 900ms, ROUGE-L 0.70
```
kevin (SRE): Nice. Int8 gives solid latency wins with tiny quality hit. For routing, compact model is clean for >3k tokens — provably cheaper.
tara (CSE): Customer-facing framing: "we can reduce tail latency and cost by testing a lightweight quantized variant and optionally routing very long docs to a compact model. We'll monitor quality closely and rollback if you see regressions." Good?
omar (Account Exec): Perfect. Add a short FAQ: what are risks, rollback plan, and whether any anchor prompts might break.
sophie (ML Eng): Rollback: revert canary to 0% and re-enable float model. Also we'll keep an A/B evaluation dashboard and set an alert for ROUGE-L drop > 1.5%.
kevin (SRE): Ops checklist I'm doing:
- [x] KV cache prefix enabled (TTL=12h)
- [x] Routing rule staged (10% canary)
- [x] Canary deployment queued
- [ ] Monitoring dashboard (latency/cost/quality) — I will have it by EOD
- [ ] Postmortem if any customer report
eng-runtime-bot: alert rule created: clarion-canary-quality-drop -> notify @sophie @tara if ROUGE-L delta > 1.0%
tara (CSE): I'll send Clarion a short note with expected timeline and ask for 48h of acceptance testing. Also capture their top 5 example docs for guardrail evals.
omar (Account Exec): On the call I'll request those examples. If they sign off on int8, we can propose a 6-month reserved-dedicated discount to lock renewal.
sophie (ML Eng): One more thought: if certain parts of the pipeline trigger high latency (e.g., long prefix embedding), consider enabling partial caching at the route-level (embedding cache). I can instrument that.
kevin (SRE): Good point. I'll add metrics for embedding compute time per request.
tara (CSE): Awesome. Owners: Sophie -> evals & quality guardrails; Kevin -> routing & dashboards; Omar -> customer comms/renewal; Tara -> enablement docs. Please update the ticket with next steps.
eng-runtime-bot: ticket CI-48291 updated: assignments set (Sophie, Kevin, Omar, Tara). Canary window open: 06h.
tara (CSE): Thanks team. Ping me on thread if anything critical pops up during the canary. :thumbsup:
omar (Account Exec): I'll post meeting notes after Tue call.
kevin (SRE): Will monitor. If we see cache hit rate < 20% after 12h, we'll widen canary to all and re-evaluate.
sophie (ML Eng): Sending eval artifacts now. Let's keep quality-first.
tara (CSE): End of thread for now. We'll follow up post-call with Clarion feedback.
